deliverable: Discover and lineage-deduplicate prior Foundry or operational-ontology reconstructions.
done_when: Artifact records materially different search families, discovered candidates, lineage decisions, and the two-family saturation result.

deliverable: Inspect gura105/operational-ontology as a minimal reference reconstruction.
done_when: Artifact records pinned revision, license, independence group, implemented semantics, failure behavior, authority model, and proposed distinctions.

deliverable: Inspect Przyval/openfoundry as a Foundry API emulator.
done_when: Artifact records pinned revision, license, API surface, ObjectSet behavior, actions, auth, service boundaries, tests, and proposed distinctions.

deliverable: Inspect syzygyhack/open-foundry as an independent operational platform.
done_when: Artifact records pinned revision, license, ontology/action/security/sync/storage boundaries, observable choices, and proposed distinctions.

deliverable: Map the official Palantir public OSDK and Platform API surface against S01-S10.
done_when: Artifact gives every REQUIRED scope ID at least one official public entry point or explicitly records that no official behavior was found in the inspected surface.

deliverable: Compute observable distinctions shared across lineage-distinct reconstructions and compare them with official surfaces.
done_when: Artifact separates official support, independent reconstruction agreement, and unsupported common assumptions for each shared distinction.

deliverable: Record material disagreements among reconstructions and between reconstructions and official public surfaces.
done_when: Every disagreement names rival claims, affected scope IDs, source lineage, and whether the difference can change the high-level model.

deliverable: Construct a materially different representation of the same REQUIRED observations and ablate or merge candidate primitives.
done_when: Artifact shows at least one rival model, maps the same observations into it, and records which candidate primitive removals preserve or lose REQUIRED distinctions.

deliverable: Separate Palantir-specific observable constraints from generic operational-ontology structure.
done_when: Artifact labels each retained constraint OFFICIAL, OBSERVED, RECONSTRUCTED, INFERRED, or UNKNOWN and names its affected scope IDs.

deliverable: Compile and review model/model.json v0 from accepted distinctions.
done_when: Artifact lists every model change, affected scope IDs, evidence class, primitive necessity result, and resulting coverage status before coordinator integration.

deliverable: Enumerate unresolved questions that can still change model structure or routing.
done_when: Artifact distinguishes decision-changing from non-decision-changing unknowns and gives a discriminator for every decision-changing item.

deliverable: Run opposite-plausible-outcome analysis for every decision-changing unknown.
done_when: Artifact records both plausible answers for every decision-changing unknown and whether each answer changes primitive structure, routing, or acceptance.

deliverable: Design the minimum authorized discriminating probes for unresolved model-changing disagreements.
done_when: Each proposed probe states rival predictions, minimum input, execution boundary, expected observations, and routing consequence; zero-value probes are excluded.

deliverable: Synthesize the high-level architecture and report acceptance status against the finite denominator.
done_when: Artifact reports covered_required/total_required, PARTIAL and UNKNOWN separately, candidate and rival models, Palantir-specific constraints, remaining unknowns, and whether HIGH_LEVEL_READY is satisfied.
